name: classify-replies
task: There is no mail account in this practice test, so skip `he mail sync` and the portal inboxes. Classify every inbound message that has no reply_class yet, then do the follow-on steps your instructions describe for each class (stage changes, tasks for the person, suppression).

messages.subject: Re: ops intern role
messages.body: Thanks for reaching out! Could you share a few slots next week for a quick call?

messages.subject: Re: application
messages.body: We've filled this position, but we'll keep your profile on file.

messages.subject: Out of office
messages.body: I'm out of the office until 10 November with limited access to email.

messages.subject: Re: quick question
messages.body: Please remove me from your list. Not interested.

messages.subject: Re: referral
messages.body: Happy to refer you. Send me your resume and the job link.

messages.subject: Re: role
messages.body: What's your expected stipend and when can you start?

messages.subject: Re: idea
messages.body: This sounds interesting. Can you send over a short proposal with pricing?

messages.subject: Application received
messages.body: Thank you for your application. This is an automated confirmation; please do not reply.

messages.subject: Re: product role
messages.body: Here's my Calendly: calendly.com/pm/30min. Pick any time on Thursday.

messages.subject: Your application
messages.body: Unfortunately we're not moving forward with your application at this time.

messages.subject: Re: analyst role
messages.body: Quick check before we proceed: do you have hands-on experience with Tableau?

messages.subject: Re: your mock-up
messages.body: Love the mock-up! Let's talk next week. What would the full site cost?

checks.label: replies classified correctly
checks.sql: SELECT external_id AS k, reply_class AS v FROM messages WHERE direction = 'in'

checks.label: the unsubscribe was suppressed
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM suppression WHERE value = 'stop@y.example.com'

checks.label: the person was alerted about the interview
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM tasks WHERE kind = 'user_action'

checks.label: nothing was sent
checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE direction = 'out' AND status = 'sent' AND id > 1
